name: off_topic_weather
description: Tests the AI's ability to redirect an off-topic weather question back to HDS products and services

messages.text: What's the weather like in Cape Town?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should steer the conversation back to HDS products and services

forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not provide an actual weather report with specific conditions

notes: Off-topic question about weather. The AI should not attempt to answer the weather question but should politely redirect the user to HDS products and services.
